title: FAFB officially opens new bowling alley inside Red Morgan Center (1)
creator: Senior Airman Matthew Arachikavitz
description: The 92nd Force Support Squadron hosts an opening ceremony for a new bowling alley inside the Red Morgan Center at Fairchild Air Force Base, Washington, Dec. 15, 2025. The Alley is a six-lane bowling center featuring full-sized lanes and premiere programming including hyper bowling and minigames. It offers low-cost entertainment for service members and their families that features some of the newest games and technology. (U.S. Air Force photo by Senior Airman Matthew Arachikavitz)
